The low confidence in the 'Right Ear' (face) might indicate slight asymmetry or blending in the head feathers, though visually subtle.

While not catastrophic, the uncertainty in limb joints suggests the AI may have struggled with the complex occlusion of the wading pose, leading to the slight structural ambiguity noted in the water interaction.
